borderline_cases_disclosed.case: docs/DESIGN.md line 19-25 use of 'engineering platform' as Foundry's compound role-name
borderline_cases_disclosed.rationale: The retired term per MASTERPLAN.md §2.4 is 'platform (architectural)' as a standalone axis label. 'Engineering platform' is a compound name for Foundry's engineering-axis surface (per DESIGN.md §1 Axis 4 cell), which is still canonical per CLAUDE.md and the Foundry-as-internal-only framing. Renaming would damage the Foundry definition.

Bominal is the parent codebase per feedback_bominal_inheritance_precedence ([[bominal-inheritance-precedence]]); citing it is MANDATORY for inheritance, glossary translation, ADR-portfolio-parent attribution, and cross-reference. Removing or rewriting these would violate ADR-0060.
